description: Use this for a gift symbol (the pattern on a gift, for example "Beetle") and its rarity, in one collection or across all collections, with direct links to /symbol/<slug> and /c/<collection>/symbol/<slug>. Omit name to list symbols of one collection. Do not use it for models or backdrops.

name.description: Symbol name. Leave empty to list the symbols of a collection.

name: get_symbol
title: Get a gift symbol
